traits.zh: 店外有黑色长条形户外桌椅，可坐至少4人
traits.en: Black outdoor bench seats for at least 4 people

traits.zh: 落地玻璃窗通透，采光良好
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling windows with good natural light

traits.zh: 菜单含美式咖啡、奶咖、椰子等招牌饮品
traits.en: Features signature drinks like Americano, milk coffee, and coconut

traits.zh: 提供油条、香肠等餐食类推荐菜
traits.en: Offers food items like youtiao and sausage as recommended dishes

traits.zh: 营业至晚上10点，周末早开一小时
traits.en: Closes at 10 PM, opens one hour earlier on weekends

focus.zh: 有吧台和手机支架，适合办公

energy.zh: 位于商场首层，人流较多

linger.zh: 有户外座位和良好采光，适合久坐
linger.en: Comfortable outdoor seating with good lighting
